outcomes.text: a hated ex who did something horrible
a mentor that cares for them

temperaments.name: Timid
temperaments.description: -5 CHA; take a knowledge skill.

temperaments.name: Outgoing
temperaments.description: +2 CHA; take an emotional intelligence skill +20%.

temperaments.name: Aloof
temperaments.description: +5 INT, -5 CHA, +5 Mana.

temperaments.name: Charming
temperaments.description: +10 CHA.

temperaments.name: Sturdy
temperaments.description: +10% Damage Resistance and +10% Limb Damage Resistance.

temperaments.name: Weak
temperaments.description: Gain Damage Vulnerability.

temperaments.name: Arcane
temperaments.description: +20% Magical Resistance.

temperaments.name: Magically sensitive
temperaments.description: Gain Magical Vulnerability.

temperaments.name: Idiot
temperaments.description: -10 INT; gain Fear and Charm Resistance +10%.

temperaments.name: Clever
temperaments.description: +10 INT.

temperaments.name: Breakable
temperaments.description: Gain Fall Vulnerability and Limb Damage Vulnerability.

temperaments.name: Logical
temperaments.description: +15 INT, -5 CHA.

temperaments.name: Heartfelt
temperaments.description: Take 2 emotional intelligence skills +2%, +5 CHA, and Charm Vulnerability.

temperaments.name: Studious
temperaments.description: Take 2 speciality skills +10% and one additional skill +10%.

temperaments.name: Spontaneous
temperaments.description: Add 2 points to 3 random stats.

temperaments.name: Passionate
temperaments.description: Choose a stat of passion. Every time you level up, add an additional point in that stat.

temperaments.name: Sober
temperaments.description: Gain Poker Face starting at level 20.

temperaments.name: Sensitive
temperaments.description: Take all vulnerabilities. Increase 10 skills by +10%.

temperaments.name: Brave
temperaments.description: Gain Fear Resistance +20% and +3 CON.

temperaments.name: Romantic
temperaments.description: Gain the Lover Boy title.
temperaments.title: Lover Boy

temperaments.name: Apathetic
temperaments.description: -5 CHA, gain Frenzy resistance at level 20.

temperaments.name: Evil
temperaments.description: Gain 5 EXP every time you succeed at a truly diabolical task.

temperaments.name: Good
temperaments.description: Gain 5 EXP every time you do something truly good.

temperaments.name: Meathead
temperaments.description: Gain 1 CON every time you level up.

temperaments.name: Whimsical
temperaments.description: Gain 1 MAG every time you level up.

temperaments.name: Hard-working
temperaments.description: When you would gain 5 EXP, gain 8.

temperaments.name: Talented
temperaments.description: When you would gain a single stat point in a stat, gain 2. This only works once per level up.

temperaments.name: Lazy
temperaments.description: When you would gain 5 EXP, only gain 4.

temperaments.name: Talentless
temperaments.description: When you would gain a single stat point in a stat, gain 0. This only happens once per level up.

temperaments.name: Genius
temperaments.description: When you see someone else gain EXP, gain 2 EXP.

temperaments.name: Athletic
temperaments.description: Gain 1 STR every time you level up.

temperaments.name: Anxious
temperaments.description: -5 levels to all emotional intelligence skills. Gain a speciality skill at level 15.

temperaments.name: Cruel
temperaments.description: Gain an additional combat skill, +3 STR.

temperaments.name: Kind
temperaments.description: +5 levels to all emotional intelligence skills.

temperaments.name: Playboy
temperaments.description: Gain Seduction at level 20, +5 CHA, -2 INT.

temperaments.name: Lonely
temperaments.description: +3 levels to all subterfuge skills and take the title Unlucky.
temperaments.title: Unlucky

temperaments.name: Selfish
temperaments.description: When only you gain EXP in an entire session, add an additional 5.

temperaments.name: Selfless
temperaments.description: When you gain EXP, you may choose to instead give it to someone else. +20 CHA.

temperaments.name: Sleepless
temperaments.description: Gain Insomnia Resistance at level 40. Roll a Constitution check to sleep well enough to rest.

temperaments.name: Sleepy
temperaments.description: Take Insomnia Vulnerability. Roll a Constitution check to wake up. If you sleep as much as desired, gain a temporary +10 to a stat of your choice.

temperaments.name: Well-read
temperaments.description: Gain two additional skills with +10%.

temperaments.name: Pacifist
temperaments.description: Unwilling to commit violence. Gain 3 emotional intelligence skills with +1% x the level of this title.

temperaments.name: Fixated
temperaments.description: Gain +60% in one skill. All other skills start at base 0%.

temperaments.name: Volatile
temperaments.description: Gain Frenzy Vulnerability and +5 STR.

temperaments.name: Dramatic
temperaments.description: Gain Fear Vulnerability, Frenzy Vulnerability, and the Idiot Savant title.
temperaments.title: Idiot Savant

temperaments.name: Iron will
temperaments.description: Gain Magical, Fear, and Charm Resistance at +1% per level.

temperaments.name: Dutiful
temperaments.description: Gain the Obsessed title and ignore its negative effects.
temperaments.title: Obsessed

temperaments.name: Obsessive
temperaments.description: Gain the Obsessed title.
temperaments.title: Obsessed

temperaments.name: Lone wolf
temperaments.description: This character is incapable of joining an organization. Upgrade an extra skill on leveling up.

temperaments.name: Rebellious
temperaments.description: This character is incapable of going above Level 10 in an organization. Gain +5 STR and +5 CON.

temperaments.name: Curious
temperaments.description: Gain +5 INT and +10% in a Perception skill.

entries.name: Risk Taker
entries.description: Gain +1% per level when doing something risky.

entries.name: Lover Boy
entries.description: Gain +1% per level when doing something romantic or sexual.

entries.name: Idiot Savant
entries.description: Choose a stat. All skills using that stat gain +1% per level in this title.

entries.name: Obsessed
entries.description: Choose an object of obsession. When you are not acting towards it, or physically around it, gain -1% x the level of this title. When you are acting towards it, or are physically around it, gain +1% x level of this title.

entries.name: Weak
entries.description: -1 STR and CON for every level.

entries.name: Idiot
entries.description: Lose 1 random stat point per title level every time you level up.

entries.name: Bloodthirsty
entries.description: Gain 10 EXP every time you kill something sentient.

entries.name: Criminal (Guild)
entries.description: Gain a marking on your forehead. All stats decreased by 10.

entries.name: Protector
entries.description: Gain light magic and one light magic spell. If magic was unavailable, MAGIC starts at 15.

entries.name: Lucky
entries.description: Add the percentage of this title's level to all rolls. Levels up when luck makes the difference.

entries.name: Unlucky
entries.description: Inverse the title Lucky.

entries.name: Coward
entries.description: Gain +1% per level to skills when running away.

entries.name: Prodigy
entries.description: Pick a stat. All values added to that stat are doubled, for a maximum of 4.

entries.name: Beloved
entries.description: A Goddess grants you use of a skill.

entries.name: Hero
entries.description: All EXP gain is multiplied by 5.

entries.name: Student
entries.description: All EXP gain is doubled; level up an additional skill at level up.

entries.name: (Type) Magician
entries.description: Gain a magic spell of this type. Add +1% per title level to all spells of this type.

entries.name: Ascendent
entries.description: Gain light or dark magic and Miracle or Calamity. For every title level, increase a stat of your choice by 2.

entries.name: Resilient
entries.description: Every time you level up, gain 4 levels in a resistance of your choice.

entries.name: Normal
entries.description: This creature is terrifically normal. All EXP gain is multiplied by 0.5.

entries.name: Peculiar
entries.description: All stat gain for this creature is randomized.

entries.name: Forsaken
entries.description: This creature has been forsaken by the Gods.

raceTitles.name: Elemental
raceTitles.description: Choose an element. You may only cast spells of this type, but gain +2% per level of this title to spellcasting.
